desc: Cumulative: mg-A-7-02 (0x74b80) + 0xf31d8: the Token-2022 TLV decoder decode_transfer_fees moves from utils/transfer_fee.rs (in-crate #[inline(never)]) into crates/native-transfer-fee as `pub fn decode_transfer_fees(&[u8]) -> Result<Option<(DecodedTransferFee, DecodedTransferFee)>, ()>` (+ private read_fee), re-exported by `pub use native_transfer_fee::{decode_transfer_fees, DecodedTransferFee};` on the same line 6 of transfer_fee.rs. Source shape (each item moves LLVM block creation order): `let is_mint = data.len() == 82; if !is_mint && data.len() < 167 {Err} if is_mint {Ok(None)}`; `let mut fees` declared before `offset`; entry check `match remaining.get(4..entry_size) {Some(v) => v, None => return Err(())}`; `let is_fee_config = kind == 1;` right after reading kind; separate `if fees.is_some() {Err}` / `if length < 108 {Err}`. Same checks, same order of evaluation, same results as the old decoder (behavior unchanged). 0xf31d8 is also raw-equal (raw 150->151). Positioning devices: none (the removed in-crate decoder was at the end of transfer_fee.rs, so no line moves).
